CustomField.description: Chooses between active inbound services whose matching paths are the same length; outgoing calls do not read it. When an incoming request matches the Endpoint Path of several active inbound services, the longest path wins. Between paths of the same length, the service with the lower number wins.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Inbound only. A lower number wins, but only between matching Endpoint Paths of the same length: otherwise the longest matching path wins.
CustomField.label: Priority
